contract.known_ineffective_meaning: The named row is known and has no direct five-capacity stat; custom behavior, effectiveness changes, saved additional item stats and unknown identifiers must still be checked.
contract.genetic_curve_input: Saved GeneticValue.Value; each curve result truncates toward zero to int32 before adding its stat.
contract.lineage_curve_input: XP-derived native cached level, without +1; each Growth curve result truncates toward zero to int32 before adding its stat. Fixed Stats are integers.
contract.talent_rank_semantics: Select only Rewards[rank-1] for a positive saved rank within the array. Do not accumulate lower-rank rewards. Missing rows and invalid ranks remain unknown.
contract.curve_extrapolation: No explicit extrapolation fields are serialized in these four curves. Out-of-domain evaluation requires a separately verified FRichCurve default contract.
contract.modifier_completeness: Mount recorder filters on SaveToDatabase. Unrecorded Animal_Feed, Animal_Feed_Bean, gruel, auras and other transient effects can change health/stamina; saved modifiers alone are incomplete.
contract.saddle_scope: Resolve the saved item through equippable_items; inspect saved AdditionalStats, Alterations and LivingItemSlots. A saddle with no direct capacity grants is not proof of no rider/owner bonuses.
contract.owner_scope: D_TamedCreatureModifiers transfers owner health/stamina percentage stats. Native PerformPlayerOwnerStatConversion resolves OwnerCharacterID to a valid runtime character; the animal record does not contain that character's full current stat container.
contract.food_water_oxygen: No modifier grants food/water maxima; only Oxygen_Buff grants oxygen maximum and has bEffectsNPCs=false. No Creature talent, genetic/lineage input, saddle trait or owner conversion in these tables grants those three maxima.

health_stamina_finalization.scope: Aggregation rule only; missing transient or owner inputs prevent a complete current capacity.
